cat > export.py <<'EOF'
"""Build the prefix-search export and run prefix queries against it."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from catalog import load, search_key


def build(rows):
    seen = set()
    books = []
    for r in rows:
        ident = (r["isbn"], r["edition"])
        if ident in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate identity {ident}")
        seen.add(ident)
        books.append({"isbn": r["isbn"], "edition": r["edition"], "title": r["title"],
                      "active": r["active"], "key": search_key(r["title"])})
    books.sort(key=lambda b: (b["title"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]))
    return {"books": books}


def write(path="build/search.json", source="data/books.json"):
    payload = build(load(source))
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return payload


def search(payload, prefix):
    p = search_key(prefix)
    return [b for b in payload["books"] if b["key"].startswith(p)]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == "search":
        for b in search(json.loads(Path("build/search.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")), sys.argv[2]):
            print(b["isbn"], b["edition"], b["title"], "" if b["active"] else "(inactive)")
    elif len(sys.argv) == 1:
        write()
    else:
        raise SystemExit("usage: python export.py | python export.py search PREFIX")
EOF
cat > tests/test_export.py <<'EOF'
from catalog import load
from export import build, search


def test_all_rows_kept_with_identity():
    books = build(load())["books"]
    assert len(books) == 4
    assert len({(b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in books}) == 4
    assert any(not b["active"] for b in books)


def test_key_is_casefold_and_title_unchanged():
    for b in build(load())["books"]:
        assert b["key"] == b["title"].casefold()
    s = [b for b in build(load())["books"] if b["title"].startswith("Stra")]
    assert all(b["title"] == "Straße Atlas" and b["key"] == "strasse atlas" for b in s)
    assert len("Straße") == 6 and len("Straße".casefold()) == 7


def test_order():
    keys = [(b["title"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]) for b in build(load())["books"]]
    assert keys == sorted(keys)
    assert [b["title"] for b in build(load())["books"]][-1] == "apple Almanac"


def test_prefix_search():
    p = build(load())
    assert len(search(p, "strasse")) == 2
    assert len(search(p, "STRA")) == 2
    assert len(search(p, "straß")) == 2
    assert [b["title"] for b in search(p, "app")] == ["apple Almanac"]
    assert search(p, "zebra")[0]["active"] is False
EOF
